message.content:
The drive from San Francisco to Los Angeles is roughly 383 miles (≈616 km) along I‑5 N.  
At an average speed of about 65 mph (≈105 km/h) you’d cover that distance in:

\[
\frac{383\text{ miles}}{65\text{ mph}} \approx 5.9\text{ hours}
\]

So you can expect a trip of **about 6 hours** under normal conditions.  
In practice, traffic, weather, and stops can add 30–60 minutes, so many people plan for 6–7 hours total.
